LESSON: JESUS’ MINISTRY IN JERUSALEM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life and Ministry of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.5: Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What was the significance of Jesus’ triumphant entry to Jerusalem?
